title: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone

entities.name: Teferi Akosa
entities.description: A time-manipulating planeswalker who washes up on a beach in Zhalfir nearly four hundred years in the past, is recognized as the man who sent Zhalfir away, and resolves to protect Zhalfir.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: An artificer who meets Teferi in the place beyond time and warns that their time is up.

entities.name: Eshe
entities.description: A hoarse-voiced guard leader of a caravan, a former member of a warband, who recognizes Teferi and tries to kill him.

entities.name: Oyana
entities.description: A young laborer in a Zhalfir fishing line who plans to join the akinji and speaks to Teferi as the father of Zhalfir.

entities.name: Adia
entities.description: A young Civic Creed acolyte, orphaned by the Keldon War, who fears what war with Phyrexia will cost.

entities.name: Jabari
entities.description: A general of Zhalfir and an old friend of Teferi who brings him to Aku.

entities.name: Queen Wezna
entities.description: The queen of Zhalfir, who declares a long wait against Phyrexia and sentences Teferi, then spares him.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A white-haired planeswalker found in an amber prison who brings news of New Phyrexia's invasion.

entities.name: Subira
entities.description: A caravanner whom Teferi loved and married, mother of Niambi, who has since died.

entities.name: Niambi
entities.description: Teferi's daughter, whom he once froze in time mid-fall and then caught.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: A dangerous prisoner of Zhalfir who escapes when his amber prison shatters.

entities.name: General Mageta
entities.description: A Zhalfirin general wounded when Kaervek's prison shattered.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker to whom Teferi was connected and whom he tries to contact through the mana well.

entities.name: Saheeli
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Teferi guesses may have helped reach Zhalfir.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem whom Teferi thinks may have been found.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A telepath of the old Gatewatch whose mind-reading Teferi compares to his own.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A planeswalker who would call the path a song.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker reported gone in the Wanderer's account.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The Phyrexian leader whose hordes Zhalfir prepares to face.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: A plane that Teferi sent into a void out of time, still preparing for a Phyrexian war.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane Zhalfir prepares to defend against Phyrexia.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The compleated plane whose invasion has begun.

entities.name: Aku
entities.description: An ancient tomb city above the Uuserk swamp, home to the Amber Tombs and where Queen Wezna waits.

entities.name: Amber Tombs
entities.description: A dome in Aku where Zhalfir keeps dangerous prisoners in amber.

entities.name: Kiingal
entities.description: A city to which the caravan is heading.

entities.name: Kipamu
entities.description: A city of Zhalfir, the claimed home of Teferi's alias Sefu.

entities.name: Creedhall
entities.description: A humble domed temple to the five creeds of magic with a mana well at the center.

entities.name: The Phyrexian War
entities.description: The coming war that Zhalfir has prepared for over generations.

entities.name: The Mirage War
entities.description: A past war that took family from most Zhalfirin.

entities.name: The Keldon War
entities.description: A past war that cost Zhalfirin families and orphaned Adia.

entities.name: The akinji
entities.description: Warriors of Zhalfir whom Oyana plans to join.

entities.name: The five creeds
entities.description: The five creeds of magic that guide Zhalfir, including the Shaper and Civic creeds.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker alliance of which Teferi was a part.

entities.name: The sylex
entities.description: A bomb whose detonation sent Teferi and Urza to a place outside time.

entities.name: The anchor
entities.description: The means that connected Teferi to the others, which has failed.

events.summary: Teferi wakes on a beach after a dreamlike conversation with Urza, with only memories of Urza saying their time was up.
events.quote: I think our time is up,

events.summary: Teferi realizes he is no longer connected to Kaya and cannot planeswalk.
events.quote: summoned up the familiar movement of a planeswalk and found nothing

events.summary: Teferi sleeps and dreams of Kroog, Argoth, and the Phyrexian stabbing him, and of Subira no longer wandering.
events.quote: The cold pressure when the Phyrexian stabbed him.

events.summary: Teferi uses time magic on the path and sees the beach decline from joyful to fearful and then empty, realizing he is in Zhalfir.
events.quote: reached into time, pulling history from the dust

events.summary: Teferi realizes he is back in Zhalfir nearly four hundred years earlier.
events.quote: Nearly four hundred years later, he was back in Zhalfir.

events.summary: Teferi steps out in front of a caravan and is held at spearpoint by its guards.
events.quote: had Teferi surrounded and at spearpoint within the minute

events.summary: Teferi lies to the guard leader that he was attacked by bandits.
events.quote: I was attacked by bandits

events.summary: Eshe introduces herself and Teferi gives a false name.
events.quote: I am Eshe.

events.summary: Teferi reads Eshe's memory of the dead comrades, learning that the guards are themselves bandits who killed ten.
events.quote: he channeled a subtle spell and pulled the answer from Eshe's memory

events.summary: A frightened caravanner warns Teferi that the guards are bandits, and Eshe realizes who he is.
events.quote: She knew who he was.

events.summary: Eshe speaks of Zhalfir's generations of war and loss and accuses a snake among them.
events.quote: Every one of us here is linked in grief,

events.summary: Eshe names Teferi as the snake who escaped Zhalfir's suffering.
events.quote: Here is Teferi, the snake.

events.summary: Eshe thrusts her spear at Teferi's heart and he freezes time.
events.quote: She lifted her spear, coiled her strength, and thrust for his heart.

events.summary: In frozen time, Teferi tells the slowed Eshe about Subira and his guilt for sending Zhalfir away.
events.quote: I loved a caravanner once,

events.summary: Teferi vows to see Zhalfir safe through what comes next.
events.quote: I will see Zhalfir safe through what comes next.

events.summary: Teferi demonstrates blue mana and resumes time, and Eshe tells him to go away.
events.quote: summoning up a fearsome blue light

events.summary: Teferi leaves the caravan alone, and Eshe departs in the opposite direction.
events.quote: Teferi went away, hurrying down the road, alone.

events.summary: Months later, Teferi works with villagers hauling a fishing net and speaks with Oyana, who calls him the father of Zhalfir.
events.quote: You are the father of Zhalfir.

events.summary: Teferi says no one can stop the Phyrexians, and Oyana withdraws.
events.quote: No one can stop them. Not even the brave.

events.summary: Teferi tries to reach Kaya through the creedhall's mana well and gets no answer.
events.quote: Can you hear me?

events.summary: Adia tells Teferi that soldiers from Kipamu are looking for him because of the war.
events.quote: Soldiers from Kipamu came looking for you.

events.summary: Teferi is reunited with the general Jabari, who has come to bring him to the queen.
events.quote: I am just Teferi Akosa now, Jabari,

events.summary: Jabari reveals another outsider has come to Zhalfir and asked for Teferi.
events.quote: You are not the only one from outside to come here.

events.summary: Teferi recognizes the described woman and her hat as the Wanderer.
events.quote: Not just any wanderer: the Wanderer.

events.summary: Adia gives Teferi mended robes and confesses she fears that return to the world means war will truly begin.
events.quote: I'm not so sure that Zhalfir returning to the world is a good thing

events.summary: Teferi recalls freezing his daughter Niambi in time and then catching her, deciding to stand with Zhalfir rather than stop the fall.
events.quote: he had frozen her in time, arresting her mid-fall

events.summary: Teferi tells Adia that Zhalfir is not just war and cannot stop what is coming but can control what follows.
events.quote: We are not bound by fate,

events.summary: Teferi, Jabari and the recruits reach Aku and learn Kaervek has escaped and General Mageta is wounded.
events.quote: Kaervek has escaped,

events.summary: Teferi sees the warding pendulum snapped and the floor shattered in the central dome of the Amber Tombs.
events.quote: With horror, Teferi saw that the pendulum had snapped

events.summary: Queen Wezna confronts Teferi and demands why she should not carry out his sentence; he answers that if she kills him, they will win.
events.quote: they will win.

events.summary: Queen Wezna orders Jabari to lead the army while General Mageta recovers.
events.quote: You will lead the army until he recovers.

events.summary: Queen Wezna tosses Teferi an amber prison holding the frozen Wanderer.
events.quote: Small, frozen in time, likely moments after planeswalking, a warrior mid-strike.

events.summary: A creed leader breaks the amber prison and the Wanderer is freed.
events.quote: the prison snapped, bursting open with a sharp report

events.summary: The Wanderer learns she has been in Zhalfir a month, and Teferi reasons the anchor failed.
events.quote: The anchor failed,

events.summary: The Wanderer tells them New Phyrexia's invasion is upon them before she flickers away.
events.quote: New Phyrexia's invasion is upon us,

events.summary: Teferi resolves that it is not too late and vows to show the Phyrexians that the sun rises in Zhalfir.
events.quote: It's not too late,

relations.note: he loved and married her; she has died
relations.quote: I am the father of Niambi and husband of Subira.
I am the father of Niambi and husband of Subira.
We loved each other, and we made a family together.

relations.note: she tries to kill him as the destroyer of Zhalfir

relations.quote: If the queen had sent his executioner, at least he was a friend.
You will lead the army until he recovers.
I serve at the pleasure of the queen.
marking her as an inductee of the Civic Creed

relations.note: Oyana calls him the Shaper and father of Zhalfir whose creeds he shaped
relations.quote: Our creeds were shaped by you.

relations.note: he sent Zhalfir away into a void
relations.quote: She didn't lose anyone when I sent Zhalfir away.

relations.note: an old companion who brings news of the invasion
relations.quote: The Wanderer crouched down next to him

relations.note: a prisoner of Zhalfir who escaped his amber prison
